units.source_text: 这更衣的父亲官居大纳言[\[2\]](#part1330.html#m2)之位，早已去世。

en.t: This lady's father had held the rank of Grand Counselor, but he had already passed away.

units.source_text: 母夫人也是名门贵族出身，看见人家女儿双亲俱全，尊荣富厚，

en.t: Her mother, too, came from a distinguished noble family, and when she saw other people's daughters with both parents living, honored and richly provided for,

units.source_text: 就巴望自己女儿不落人后，每逢参与庆吊等仪式，总是尽心竭力，

en.t: she longed for her own daughter not to fall behind them, and whenever she took part in ceremonies of celebration or mourning, she always did everything in her power,

units.source_text: 百般调度，在人前装体面。

en.t: making every possible arrangement so that she could keep up appearances before others.

units.source_text: 只可惜缺乏有力的保护者，万一发生意外，

en.t: It was only a pity that she lacked a powerful protector, and if anything unexpected were to happen,

units.source_text: 势必孤立无援，心中不免凄凉。

en.t: she would surely be left isolated and without help, so her heart could not help feeling desolate.
